active_loop.seed: One label-informed positive and one negative minimizing SHA-256(review NUL canonical record identity), positive first.
active_loop.tie_rule: Stable descending scores over ascending canonical record identity.

decision_rule: Admit only U4_PLUS_TITLE_A250 and only if G1-G9 all pass. Otherwise discard the title residual and retain exact u4. TITLE_ONLY_U4 remains an ablation only.
execution_limit: One execution only; no grid, tuning, retry, pytest, repository CI, git operation, manuscript or shared-file edit.
forbidden_claims: source-general, domain-general, workflow-general or application-exact superiority

frozen_arms.EXACT_U4: Exact V8/V7 u4 word TF-IDF, LinearSVC C=0.11 squared_hinge random_state=20260823, 9.8 balancer and unchanged active loop.
frozen_arms.TITLE_ONLY_U4: Title-emphasis title + title + abstract with the same exact u4 learner, balancer and loop.
frozen_arms.U4_PLUS_TITLE_A250: Per active batch, population-z-score exact-u4 and title-only pool scores and rank z_u4 + 0.25*(z_title-z_u4).

single_change_from_v9: For the exact Appenzeller-Herzog_2020 content group d1b054eda2f1fb8dea2e3ad78c9d32aba9819f9d2465b6509949ec11f4117bd4 only, retain both provider-native nonduplicate rows 1003 and 1018 and distinguish their canonical row identities by provider record_id. No label is selected or rewritten; every other V9 rule is unchanged.

source_population.retention: All seven reviews and both source-native rows in the repaired group must bind and execute; no review or row deletion after outcome access.
source_population.unit: review decision, unweighted across exactly seven reviews

unchanged_gates.G1_BINDING: All exact source, V8, V9 and V10 freeze/runner hashes match.
unchanged_gates.G2_SOURCE_CONTENT_AND_POPULATION: All seven repaired populations bind, are disjoint from the prior-family union and cross-review peers, and contain both classes.
